name: Amazon (AWS) Gregory Hills Data Centre
notes: 43-61 Turner Road, Gregory Hills (Camden LGA); Amazon sought early-works consent Jan 2025 for ~A$450M data centre (local press); part of AWS ap-southeast-2 Sydney region expansion; replaces the abandoned Smeaton Grange site; AWS does not publish per-site MW.

name: Amazon Smeaton Grange Data Centre (52 Turner Road) - abandoned
notes: 52 Turner Road, Smeaton Grange (Camden LGA); 40MW data centre proposal sought SEARs Feb 2024; abandoned by Amazon in Nov 2024, project relocated to 43-61 Turner Road, Gregory Hills; Baxtel lists 'Amazon Smeaton Grange B4' (unverified directory entry). Status recorded as unknown because the proposal was withdrawn by the applicant rather than refused.

name: AirTrunk Kurri Kurri Data Centre (Hart Road, Loxford)
notes: 540MW data centre proposed on the former Hydro Aluminium Kurri Kurri Smelter site, Hart Road, Loxford (Cessnock LGA); SEARs filed with NSW Government; assessed as State Significant Development; ~A$5bn project; AirTrunk seeking Hunter renewable-energy partners; local opposition over water impacts.

name: Leading Edge Data Centres Coffs Harbour
notes: Tier III (Uptime Institute certified) regional edge data centre operated by LEDC in Coffs Harbour (Coffs Harbour LGA); provides 400GB fibre links for local production/connectivity; capacity not disclosed.

name: Goodman Project Pluto Data Centre (SSD-69223466)
notes: 132 McCredie Road, Guildford West (Cumberland LGA); SSD-69223466 approved - A$1.11bn two-stage 68MW data centre (9 data halls, electrical substation, switching station; 29,444 sqm GFA on 7.17 ha); EIS referred to 126MW load capacity across two three-storey buildings; approval per trade press (urbandigest/w.media); planning portal record is the stable anchor - verify determination there.

name: Leading Edge Data Centres Dubbo
notes: LEDC regional edge data centre in Dubbo (Dubbo Regional LGA); opened 10 Dec 2021; ~A$7.7M investment; serves Central and Far West NSW businesses with cloud access; capacity not disclosed.
